subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot WebSocket reconnection causes "Outbound not configured for channel: qqbot" error

question: Should the remaining outbound-delivery investigation be folded into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78898, or tracked as a separate QQBot reconnect recovery after a current-main live reproduction?
rationale: The open PR addresses RECONNECT(7) session preservation, whereas this issue reports outbound delivery failing after reconnection; the available evidence shows overlap but not that one patch safely resolves both behaviors.

options.title: Validate and split if needed
options.body: Run a current-main QQBot 4009 reconnect scenario and open or revive a narrowly scoped outbound recovery only if heartbeat or cron delivery remains unavailable.

options.title: Fold into resume work
options.body: Extend the open reconnect PR only if a live trace shows preserving session state also restores the outbound delivery registration invariant.

recommendation.title: Validate and split if needed
recommendation.body: Run a current-main QQBot 4009 reconnect scenario and open or revive a narrowly scoped outbound recovery only if heartbeat or cron delivery remains unavailable.

likelyOwner.reason: sliverp is the recorded assignee and can decide whether the related reconnect PR should own this follow-up.
